Motivation: 现有技能式机器人编程虽具灵活性，但普遍忽视运动序列优化，导致执行过程存在效率损失。

Method: 提出一种在技能式编程框架中集成运动序列优化的规划方法，并据此设计新的 MoveContinuousSkill；其执行软件部署在可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）上。

Result: 在多个机器人系统上的实验表明，采用优化后的运动序列可显著缩短执行时间。

Conclusion: 将运动序列优化融入技能式机器人编程能够显著提升执行效率，且在多种机器人系统中具有可实施性。

Abstract: Skill-based programming of robots provides a flexible approach for automation. Existing solutions neglect the optimization of motion sequences, leading to inefficiencies in execution. This work introduces a planning method that enhances skill-based robot programming by integrating motion sequence optimization. This optimization leads to a new MoveContinuousSkill. The software for executing the MoveContinuousSkill is implemented on a Programmable Logic Controller and applied across multiple robotic systems. Experimental results demonstrate a significant improvement in execution time through optimized motion sequence.

</details>


### [488] [LangGap: Diagnosing and Closing the Language Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00592)
*Yuchen Hou,Lin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文指出：VLA高分不等于懂语言。作者提出LangGap，通过固定场景+语义扰动强测语言理解，发现现有模型大量依赖非语言线索。数据增强虽有帮助（0→90%/28%），但在高语义多样性下仍崩溃，暴露VLA语言泛化的核心瓶颈。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA在标准基准上成功率高（>95%），但可能并未真正理解语言。已有工作缺少系统语义扰动诊断、缺少“按设计强制语言理解”的基准、以及缺少语言多样化训练数据，因此需要新的评测框架揭示并缓解语言理解缺陷。

Method: 提出LangGap基准：在固定桌面布局下，通过四维语义扰动系统性改变指令语义，全面组合同一布局中的抓取-放置任务，迫使模型依赖语言而非布局记忆；并通过定向数据增强进行单任务与多任务训练对比，评估语言能力提升幅度。

Result: 在LangGap上，SOTA模型（如π0.5）暴露出明显语言理解不足。定向数据增强可部分缩小差距：单任务训练成功率由0%提升至90%，多任务由0%提升至28%。但当扩展任务语义多样性继续增加时，模型学习能力严重不足，甚至已训练任务表现也下降。

Conclusion: 当前VLA模型在高基准分数下仍存在显著“语言鸿沟”：对多样化语义指令的真实理解能力不足，且随着语义多样性提升，模型容量瓶颈明显。LangGap可作为长期评估与推动该问题研究的关键基准。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models achieve over 95% success on standard benchmarks. However, through systematic experiments, we find that current state-of-the-art VLA models largely ignore language instructions. Prior work lacks: (1) systematic semantic perturbation diagnostics, (2) a benchmark that forces language understanding by design, and (3) linguistically diverse training data. This paper constructs the LangGap benchmark, based on a four-dimensional semantic perturbation method -- varying instruction semantics while keeping the tabletop layout fixed -- revealing language understanding deficits in {\pi}0.5. Existing benchmarks like LIBERO assign only one task per layout, underutilizing available objects and target locations; LangGap fully diversifies pick-and-place tasks under identical layouts, forcing models to truly understand language. Experiments show that targeted data augmentation can partially close the language gap -- success rate improves from 0% to 90% with single-task training, and 0% to 28% with multi-task training. However, as semantic diversity of extended tasks increases, model learning capacity proves severely insufficient; even trained tasks perform poorly. This reveals a fundamental challenge for VLA models in understanding diverse language instructions -- precisely the long-term value of LangGap.

</details>


### [489] [AI-IO: An Aerodynamics-Inspired Real-Time Inertial Odometry for Quadrotors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00597)
*Jiahao Cui,Feng Yu,Linzuo Zhang,Yu Hu,Danping Zou*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这篇工作把“物理先验+学习模型”结合起来：在四旋翼惯性里程计中除了IMU再引入旋翼转速，并用Transformer做时序去噪与动力学建模，显著提升速度估计精度；再配合不确定性感知EKF，在真实数据和实时飞行中都更准、更稳、更能泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习式IO多仅用IMU或附加推力信息，但缺少可解释、成体系的物理建模，导致泛化受限和精度不足。作者希望从空气动力学与IMU测量模型出发，找到更关键且可测的物理量来提升学习效果。

Method: 提出一种面向四旋翼的Transformer惯性里程计框架：输入IMU与旋翼转速（关键物理量），利用Transformer捕获长时序依赖以进行去噪与空气动力学相关建模；输出速度估计并与不确定性感知EKF融合，形成完整状态估计流程；同时发布包含IMU与转速的高速真实飞行数据集用于评测。

Result: 加入旋翼转速后，速度预测精度提升36.9%；采用Transformer进行时序建模后，相比以往结果再提升22.4%；在多数据集与实时系统验证中表现出更优的准确性、泛化性与实时性能。

Conclusion: 通过引入与物理模型一致的转速观测并采用Transformer进行时序建模，再结合不确定性感知EKF，该方法在四旋翼惯性里程计中实现了更高精度、更强泛化与实时可用性。

Abstract: Inertial Odometry (IO) has gained attention in quadrotor applications due to its sole reliance on inertial measurement units (IMUs), attributed to its lightweight design, low cost, and robust performance across diverse environments. However, most existing learning-based inertial odometry systems for quadrotors either use only IMU data or include additional dynamics-related inputs such as thrust, but still lack a principled formulation of the underlying physical model to be learned. This lack of interpretability hampers the model's ability to generalize and often limits its accuracy. In this work, we approach the inertial odometry learning problem from a different perspective. Inspired by the aerodynamics model and IMU measurement model, we identify the key physical quantity--rotor speed measurements required for inertial odometry and design a transformer-based inertial odometry. By incorporating rotor speed measurements, the proposed model improves velocity prediction accuracy by 36.9%. Furthermore, the transformer architecture more effectively exploits temporal dependencies for denoising and aerodynamics modeling, yielding an additional 22.4% accuracy gain over previous results. To support evaluation, we also provide a real-world quadrotor flight dataset capturing IMU measurements and rotor speed for high-speed motion. Finally, combined with an uncertainty-aware extended Kalman filter (EKF), our framework is validated across multiple datasets and real-time systems, demonstrating superior accuracy, generalization, and real-time performance. We share the code and data to promote further research ( ).

</details>


### [490] [I-Perceive: A Foundation Model for Active Perception with Language Instructions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00600)
*Yongxi Huang,Zhuohang Wang,Wenjing Tang,Cewu Lu,Panpan Cai*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: I-Perceive 是一个“看图+听指令”来主动选相机视角的基础模型，结合 VLM 的语义理解与几何模型的空间推理，在大规模室内环境中比现有方法更准、更能按指令执行，并具备良好零样本泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有主动感知方法多局限于局部小场景（如桌面）和固定目标（如去遮挡），难以在真实非结构化环境中根据开放式任务意图主动调整观察视角，因此需要一种可语言条件化、可扩展到大场景的通用方法。

Method: 提出面向移动操作机器人的主动感知基础模型 I-Perceive：输入为图像场景上下文与自然语言指令，输出满足指令的相机视角。模型结构上融合视觉-语言模型（VLM）骨干与几何基础模型，以联合建模语义理解和空间几何推理。训练数据来自真实场景扫描与仿真数据，并通过自动化、可扩展流水线生成。

Result: 实验显示：相较于最先进VLM基线，I-Perceive 在相机视角预测准确性和指令跟随能力上显著提升；并在新场景、新任务上表现出较强零样本泛化。

Conclusion: I-Perceive 通过融合语义与几何先验，并以自然语言指令驱动视角预测，可在大尺度室内场景中实现开放式主动感知，且在精度、指令跟随与泛化能力上优于现有方法。

Abstract: Active perception, the ability of a robot to proactively adjust its viewpoint to acquire task-relevant information, is essential for robust operation in unstructured real-world environments. While critical for downstream tasks such as manipulation, existing approaches have largely been confined to local settings (e.g., table-top scenes) with fixed perception objectives (e.g., occlusion reduction). Addressing active perception with open-ended intents in large-scale environments remains an open challenge. To bridge this gap, we propose I-Perceive, a foundation model for active perception conditioned on natural language instructions, designed for mobile manipulators and indoor environments. I-Perceive predicts camera views that follows open-ended language instructions, based on image-based scene contexts. By fusing a Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with a geometric foundation model, I-Perceive bridges semantic and geometric understanding, thus enabling effective reasoning for active perception. We train I-Perceive on a diverse dataset comprising real-world scene-scanning data and simulation data, both processed via an automated and scalable data generation pipeline. Experiments demonstrate that I-Perceive significantly outperforms state-of-the-art VLMs in both prediction accuracy and instruction following of generated camera views, and exhibits strong zero-shot generalization to novel scenes and tasks.

</details>

Abstract: The performance of robotic imitation learning is fundamentally limited by data quality and training strategies. Prevalent sampling strategies on RLBench suffer from severe keyframe redundancy and imbalanced temporal distribution, leading to inefficient memory usage and unstable optimization. Moreover, reprojecting point clouds onto multi-view images with a black background--while more efficient than voxel-based methods--often causes dark objects to be indistinguishable and hard to manipulate. In this work, we propose a novel holistic framework that significantly improves both model performance and training efficiency. First, we redesign and optimize the keyframe sampling strategy, reducing memory consumption by 80% and accelerating training speed by 5x. Second, we augment the model with a color inversion projection branch--a simple yet effective module that resolves the ambiguity of dark objects. Finally, we propose a task-guided mixup technique that dynamically fuses point clouds and action heatmaps according to task instructions, greatly improving robustness to distractors and performance in multi-goal scenarios. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance with a 90.5% success rate on RLBench and 68.8% on the COLOSSEUM benchmark under challenging interference conditions. Our code and checkpoints are available at .

</details>


### [492] [Validation of Space Robotics in Underwater Environments via Disturbance Robustness Equivalency](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00628)
*Joris Verhagen,Elias Krantz,Chelsea Sidrane,David Dörner,Nicola De Carli,Pedro Roque,Huina Mao,Gunnar Tibert,Ivan Stenius,Christer Fuglesang,Dimos Dimarogonas,Jana Tumova*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者提出了一个把“水下中性浮力实验”与“真实空间任务”对齐的验证框架：用STL描述任务、用最大扰动鲁棒性做等价约束来规划任务，并用近似同构控制器执行；再通过在线扰动估计与鲁棒度比较来判定验证是否可信。双实验（真实水下+空间平台/高保真仿真）证明该方法能更可靠地把水下结果外推到空间场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下中性浮力环境虽常用于近似微重力验证，但与真实空间在动力学与环境上仍存在差异，导致“水下实验结果能否代表空间表现”这一关键问题未被充分解决。该研究旨在建立可量化、可对齐的验证机制。

Method: 提出一个空间机器人实验验证框架：1）将高层任务用信号时序逻辑（STL）形式化；2）以“最大扰动鲁棒性”作为桥梁，构造运动规划问题，使空间任务与水下验证任务具有相同的扰动鲁棒度；3）在验证平台上采用与空间任务近似一致的闭环控制策略，并在控制中显式考虑航天器动力学；4）执行中估计扰动并与鲁棒度阈值比较，评估验证有效性。

Result: 通过双实验设置验证框架有效性：一是近中性浮力水下机器人实验，二是与实验平面航天器平台或高保真CubeSat空间动力学仿真对照。结果显示该框架可在规划与控制层面实现跨环境一致性，并可用扰动估计对空间可操作性进行证据化评估。

Conclusion: 该工作表明：通过“最大扰动鲁棒性”等价原则，可以将水下中性浮力实验与空间任务在任务层面进行可比验证，从而为真实空间环境下的可行性提供实证依据。

Abstract: We present an experimental validation framework for space robotics that leverages underwater environments to approximate microgravity dynamics. While neutral buoyancy conditions make underwater robotics an excellent platform for space robotics validation, there are still dynamical and environmental differences that need to be overcome. Given a high-level space mission specification, expressed in terms of a Signal Temporal Logic specification, we overcome these differences via the notion of maximal disturbance robustness of the mission. We formulate the motion planning problem such that the original space mission and the validation mission achieve the same disturbance robustness degree. The validation platform then executes its mission plan using a near-identical control strategy to the space mission where the closed-loop controller considers the spacecraft dynamics. Evaluating our validation framework relies on estimating disturbances during execution and comparing them to the disturbance robustness degree, providing practical evidence of operation in the space environment. Our evaluation features a dual-experiment setup: an underwater robot operating under near-neutral buoyancy conditions to validate the planning and control strategy of either an experimental planar spacecraft platform or a CubeSat in a high-fidelity space dynamics simulator.

</details>


### [493] [Optimal Solutions for the Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem via Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00663)
*Anoop Bhat,Geordan Gutow,Zhongqiang Ren,Sivakumar Rathinam,Howie Choset*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者为移动目标车辆路径问题提出精确算法BPRC，通过新的标号与支配规则高效解决困难的定价子问题；在25目标内实验中，比现有基线快10倍以上且保持最优性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MT-VRP需要在速度、时间窗和容量约束下拦截移动目标，问题包含时变代价且复杂度高；现有分支定价方法在定价子问题上困难突出，亟需更高效且可精确求解的方法。

Method: 采用分支定价框架（Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity）。核心在定价子问题：作者设计了新的标号算法，并提出适用于移动目标与时变旅行代价的支配准则来高效生成列。

Result: 在最多25个目标的实验实例上，该算法均可求得最优解；相较于基于既有工作的基线方法，求解速度提升超过一个数量级，并在容量受限场景表现更强。

Conclusion: 本文提出的BPRC（带放松连续性的分支定价）能够精确求解MT-VRP，并通过针对移动目标设计的标号算法与支配准则显著提升求解效率，尤其在载荷受限场景下优势明显。

Abstract: The Moving Target Vehicle Routing Problem (MT-VRP) seeks trajectories for several agents that intercept a set of moving targets, subject to speed, time window, and capacity constraints. We introduce an exact algorithm, Branch-and-Price with Relaxed Continuity (BPRC), for the MT-VRP. The main challenge in a branch-and-price approach for the MT-VRP is the pricing subproblem, which is complicated by moving targets and time-dependent travel costs between targets. Our key contribution is a new labeling algorithm that solves this subproblem by means of a novel dominance criterion tailored for problems with moving targets. Numerical results on instances with up to 25 targets show that our algorithm finds optimal solutions more than an order of magnitude faster than a baseline based on previous work, showing particular strength in scenarios with limited agent capacities.

</details>


### [494] [Wild-Drive: Off-Road Scene Captioning and Path Planning via Robust Multi-modal Routing and Efficient Large Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00694)
*Zihang Wang,Xu Li,Benwu Wang,Wenkai Zhu,Xieyuanli Chen,Dong Kong,Kailin Lyu,Yinan Du,Yiming Peng,Haoyang Che*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出面向越野自动驾驶的 Wild-Drive：用 MoRo-Former 动态选择可靠模态，并结合高效 LLM+planning token+GRU 同时做结构化场景描述和轨迹规划；新建 OR-C2P 基准验证其在雨雾雪暗等退化条件下比现有方法更准、更稳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有场景描述方法主要面向结构化城市场景，在越野环境中易受单一模态退化影响，且缺乏同时建模“可解释场景描述+路径规划”的统一框架，限制了自动驾驶系统透明性与安全部署。

Method: 提出 Wild-Drive 框架：1) 使用现代多模态编码器提取视觉/传感信息；2) 设计任务条件的模态路由桥 MoRo-Former，在雨雾雪暗等退化条件下自适应聚合可靠模态；3) 融合高效 LLM，并引入 planning token 与 GRU 解码器，联合生成结构化场景 caption 与未来路径轨迹；4) 构建 OR-C2P 基准用于结构化越野 caption+规划联合评测。

Result: 在 OR-C2P 和自采数据集上的实验表明：Wild-Drive 相比既有 LLM 方法取得更优性能，并在传感退化场景下表现出更高稳定性与鲁棒性。

Conclusion: Wild-Drive 通过多模态自适应路由与轻量级语言-规划联合建模，在越野退化感知条件下可实现更稳健的结构化场景描述与轨迹预测，整体性能优于现有 LLM 基线。

Abstract: Explainability and transparent decision-making are essential for the safe deployment of autonomous driving systems. Scene captioning summarizes environmental conditions and risk factors in natural language, improving transparency, safety, and human--robot interaction. However, most existing approaches target structured urban scenarios; in off-road environments, they are vulnerable to single-modality degradations caused by rain, fog, snow, and darkness, and they lack a unified framework that jointly models structured scene captioning and path planning. To bridge this gap, we propose Wild-Drive, an efficient framework for off-road scene captioning and path planning. Wild-Drive adopts modern multimodal encoders and introduces a task-conditioned modality-routing bridge, MoRo-Former, to adaptively aggregate reliable information under degraded sensing. It then integrates an efficient large language model (LLM), together with a planning token and a gate recurrent unit (GRU) decoder, to generate structured captions and predict future trajectories. We also build the OR-C2P Benchmark, which covers structured off-road scene captioning and path planning under diverse sensor corruption conditions. Experiments on OR-C2P dataset and a self-collected dataset show that Wild-Drive outperforms prior LLM-based methods and remains more stable under degraded sensing. The code and benchmark will be publicly available at .

</details>


### [495] [Keyframe-Guided Structured Rewards for Reinforcement Learning in Long-Horizon Laboratory Robotics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00719)
*Yibo Qiu,Shu'ang Sun,Haoliang Ye,Ronald X Xu,Mingzhai Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该工作通过“关键帧+分阶段目标+几何进度奖励”把生物实验步骤逻辑显式注入强化学习，在真实长时程实验室任务中以更短在线微调时间取得82%成功率，明显超过现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 实验室自动化中的长时程精密操作需要同时满足严格步骤逻辑与连续高维控制，但现有方法受限于奖励稀疏、多阶段结构约束及示教噪声，导致探索低效和收敛不稳定。

Method: 提出关键帧引导奖励生成框架：从示教中自动提取具运动学感知的关键帧；在潜空间中用扩散预测器生成分阶段目标；基于几何进度构建奖励并用于在线强化学习；结合多视角视觉编码、潜空间相似度进度跟踪，以及在Vision-Language-Action骨干上的人类在环强化微调。

Result: 在4个真实实验室任务（含高精度吸头装配与动态液体转移）上，在线微调40–60分钟后平均成功率达82%；显著优于HG-DAgger的42%和Hil-ConRFT的47%。

Conclusion: 结构化关键帧引导奖励能够有效缓解长时程实验室精密操作中的稀疏奖励与探索瓶颈问题，为高精度、可扩展的机器人实验室自动化提供可行路径。

Abstract: Long-horizon precision manipulation in laboratory automation, such as pipette tip attachment and liquid transfer, requires policies that respect strict procedural logic while operating in continuous, high-dimensional state spaces. However, existing approaches struggle with reward sparsity, multi-stage structural constraints, and noisy or imperfect demonstrations, leading to inefficient exploration and unstable convergence. We propose a Keyframe-Guided Reward Generation Framework that automatically extracts kinematics-aware keyframes from demonstrations, generates stage-wise targets via a diffusion-based predictor in latent space, and constructs a geometric progress-based reward to guide online reinforcement learning. The framework integrates multi-view visual encoding, latent similarity-based progress tracking, and human-in-the-loop reinforcement fine-tuning on a Vision-Language-Action backbone to align policy optimization with the intrinsic stepwise logic of biological protocols. Across four real-world laboratory tasks, including high-precision pipette attachment and dynamic liquid transfer, our method achieves an average success rate of 82% after 40--60 minutes of online fine-tuning. Compared with HG-DAgger (42%) and Hil-ConRFT (47%), our approach demonstrates the effectiveness of structured keyframe-guided rewards in overcoming exploration bottlenecks and providing a scalable solution for high-precision, long-horizon robotic laboratory automation.

</details>


### [496] [UniHM: Unified Dexterous Hand Manipulation with Vision Language Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00732)
*Zhenhao Zhang,Jiaxin Liu,Ye Shi,Jingya Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Planning physically feasible dexterous hand manipulation is a central challenge in robotic manipulation and Embodied AI. Prior work typically relies on object-centric cues or precise hand-object interaction sequences, foregoing the rich, compositional guidance of open-vocabulary instruction. We introduce UniHM, the first framework for unified dexterous hand manipulation guided by free-form language commands. We propose a Unified Hand-Dexterous Tokenizer that maps heterogeneous dexterous-hand morphologies into a single shared codebook, improving cross-dexterous hand generalization and scalability to new morphologies. Our vision language action model is trained solely on human-object interaction data, eliminating the need for massive real-world teleoperation datasets, and demonstrates strong generalizability in producing human-like manipulation sequences from open-ended language instructions. To ensure physical realism, we introduce a physics-guided dynamic refinement module that performs segment-wise joint optimization under generative and temporal priors, yielding smooth and physically feasible manipulation sequences. Across multiple datasets and real-world evaluations, UniHM attains state-of-the-art results on both seen and unseen objects and trajectories, demonstrating strong generalization and high physical feasibility. Our project page at \href{ }{ }.

### [497] [Online Generation of Collision-Free Trajectories in Dynamic Environments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00759)
*Nermin Covic,Bakir Lacevic*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 把任意规划路径在线“翻译”为可执行的限跃度样条轨迹，支持高频重规划与流式控制，在动态环境中兼顾平滑、快速和短时无碰撞，并已在真实机器人上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统路径规划器（如RRT/PRM/ARA*）通常只给出几何路径，难以直接满足机器人执行时的平滑性、跃度约束与实时重规划需求；在环境和目标频繁变化时，需要一种可在线、低时延、可执行的轨迹生成方法。

Method: 提出在线轨迹转换框架：输入为状态序列路径，输出为由五次/四次样条组成的轨迹；轨迹可按用户设定控制频率离散并流式发送到底层控制器；支持在任意时刻基于当前状态重新规划到目标状态/序列；在允许有限几何偏差的前提下满足速度、加速度与跃度等运动学约束，并提供动态环境中的短时无碰撞保证。

Result: 仿真对比显示，相比竞争方法在平滑性、计算时间和实时性能上更优，尤其在目标状态高频变化（最高约1 kHz）场景下表现突出；真实机器人实验（含有人在场）验证了方法的可落地性。

Conclusion: 该方法能够将任意规划器输出的几何路径在线转换为运动学可行且限跃度的轨迹，并在动态环境下保持实时性与一定时域内的无碰撞保证，适用于真实机器人场景。

Abstract: In this paper, we present an online method for converting an arbitrary geometric path represented by a sequence of states, generated by any planner (e.g., sampling-based planners like RRT or PRM, search-based planners like ARA*, etc.), into a corresponding kinematically feasible, jerk-limited trajectory. The method generates a sequence of quintic/quartic splines that can be discretized at a user-specified control rate, and then streamed to a low-level robot controller. Our approach enables real-time adaptation to newly captured changes in the environment. It can also be re-invoked at any time instance to generate a new trajectory from the robot's current to a desired target state or sequence of states. We can guarantee that the trajectory will remain collision-free for a certain amount of time in dynamic environments, while allowing bounded geometric deviation from the original path. The kinematic constraints are taken into account, including limited jerk. We validate the approach in a comparative simulation study against the competing method, demonstrating favorable behavior w.r.t. smoothness, computational time, and real-time performance, particularly in scenarios with frequent changes of target states (up to 1 [kHz]). Experiments on a real robot demonstrate that the proposed approach can be used in real-world scenarios including human presence.

</details>


### [498] [Hippo: High-performance Interior-Point and Projection-based Solver for Generic Constrained Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00871)
*Haizhou Zhao,Ludovic Righetti,Majid Khadiv*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出 Hippo 轨迹优化器：用带自适应障碍更新的内点法处理不等式约束、用投影/IPM处理硬等式约束；在 locomotion 和 manipulation 等难题上，相比传统 SQP/DDP 求解器更快、更稳、解更好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于SQP或DDP的轨迹优化器在机器人复杂任务中常受限于计算效率慢、建模灵活性不足，以及在含硬约束问题上的收敛性差。

Method: 提出求解器 Hippo：对不等式约束采用内点法（IPM）并使用自适应障碍更新策略；对硬等式约束采用投影法或IPM处理；并通过大规模数值基准与现有SQP/DDP类方法对比。

Result: 实验基准表明，Hippo 在高难度机器人轨迹优化（如行走与操作）中表现出更好的鲁棒性与效率，并能得到高质量解。

Conclusion: Hippo 通过将内点法与自适应障碍参数更新结合，并支持硬等式约束处理，在复杂机器人轨迹优化任务中可作为现有SOTA求解器的高效且鲁棒替代方案。

Abstract: Trajectory optimization is the core of modern model-based robotic control and motion planning. Existing trajectory optimizers, based on sequential quadratic programming (SQP) or differential dynamic programming (DDP), are often limited by their slow computation efficiency, low modeling flexibility, and poor convergence for complex tasks requiring hard constraints. In this paper, we introduce Hippo, a solver that can handle inequality constraints using the interior-point method (IPM) with an adaptive barrier update strategy and hard equality constraints via projection or IPM. Through extensive numerical benchmarks, we show that Hippo is a robust and efficient alternative to existing state-of-the-art solvers for difficult robotic trajectory optimization problems requiring high-quality solutions, such as locomotion and manipulation.

</details>


### [499] [Minimalist Compliance Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00913)
*Haochen Shi,Songbo Hu,Yifan Hou,Weizhuo Wang,Karen Liu,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 用电机自身电流/电压信号估计外力，再做任务空间导纳控制，就能在不加力传感器、不用强化学习的情况下实现通用、安全、稳定的机器人顺应控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统顺应控制依赖力/力矩传感器，硬件成本与集成门槛高；基于强化学习的替代方案存在仿真到现实差距、安全性不足及系统复杂度高等问题。作者希望以最小硬件与系统改动实现可靠顺应控制。

Method: 提出Minimalist Compliance Control：仅利用伺服电机可得的电流或电压信号，结合机器人雅可比矩阵估计外部力/力矩（wrench），并将估计结果注入任务空间导纳控制器，实现顺应行为。方法具备平台无关（embodiment-agnostic）与即插即用特性。

Result: 在机械臂、灵巧手及两台人形机器人上，跨多种接触密集任务进行验证，并与视觉语言模型、模仿学习和基于模型规划结合。实验显示该方法在不同机体和规划范式下均具备鲁棒、安全且顺应的交互表现。

Conclusion: 该方法在无需力传感器、无需电流闭环控制、无需强化学习的前提下，可在多种机器人平台上实现稳定、响应快且安全的顺应控制，并可与多类高层规划器无缝集成。

Abstract: Compliance control is essential for safe physical interaction, yet its adoption is limited by hardware requirements such as force torque sensors. While recent reinforcement learning approaches aim to bypass these constraints, they often suffer from sim-to-real gaps, lack safety guarantees, and add system complexity. We propose Minimalist Compliance Control, which enables compliant behavior using only motor current or voltage signals readily available in modern servos and quasi-direct-drive motors, without force sensors, current control, or learning. External wrenches are estimated from actuator signals and Jacobians and incorporated into a task-space admittance controller, preserving sufficient force measurement accuracy for stable and responsive compliance control. Our method is embodiment-agnostic and plug-and-play with diverse high-level planners. We validate our approach on a robot arm, a dexterous hand, and two humanoid robots across multiple contact-rich tasks, using vision-language models, imitation learning, and model-based planning. The results demonstrate robust, safe, and compliant interaction across embodiments and planning paradigms.

</details>


### [500] [DAM-VLA: A Dynamic Action Model-Based Vision-Language-Action Framework for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00926)
*Xiongfeng Peng,Jiaqian Yu,Dingzhe Li,Yixiang Jin,Lu Xu,Yamin Mao,Chao Zhang,Weiming Li,Sujin Jang,Dongwook Lee,Daehyun Ji*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DAM-VLA把“看懂任务”的VLM与“做精动作”的扩散控制模型解耦并动态协同：先路由到合适动作专家，再用双尺度权重协调臂与夹爪，因此在仿真和真实场景都显著提升成功率与泛化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA多由预训练VLM改造而来，虽具任务泛化能力，但难兼顾复杂动态环境中的粗粒度移动与精细操控，导致在接触丰富、长时程任务上精度和鲁棒性不足。

Method: 提出动态动作模型驱动的VLA框架：1）动作路由机制，基于任务相关视觉/语言线索在机械臂与夹爪等专用动作模型间选择；2）动态动作模型，将高层VLM语义推理与低层视觉特征融合，用扩散式动作模型预测控制；3）双尺度动作加权机制，动态协调机械臂运动与夹爪操作。

Result: 在SIMPLER、FurnitureBench及真实机器人实验中，相比SOTA VLA方法获得更高任务成功率；在标准pick-and-place以及更具挑战的长时程、接触密集任务上均表现出更强泛化与稳定性。

Conclusion: DAM-VLA通过动态路由与双尺度加权，在通用任务适应性与精细操作精度之间取得更好平衡，能在仿真与真实场景中稳定完成从基础抓放到长时程、强接触任务。

Abstract: In dynamic environments such as warehouses, hospitals, and homes, robots must seamlessly transition between gross motion and precise manipulations to complete complex tasks. However, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks, largely adapted from pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs), often struggle to reconcile general task adaptability with the specialized precision required for intricate manipulation. To address this challenge, we propose DAM-VLA, a dynamic action model-based VLA framework. DAM-VLA integrates VLM reasoning with diffusion-based action models specialized for arm and gripper control. Specifically, it introduces (i) an action routing mechanism, using task-specific visual and linguistic cues to select appropriate action models (e.g., arm movement or gripper manipulation), (ii) a dynamic action model that fuses high-level VLM cognition with low-level visual features to predict actions, and (iii) a dual-scale action weighting mechanism that enables dynamic coordination between the arm-movement and gripper-manipulation models. Across extensive evaluations, DAM-VLA achieves superior success rates compared to state-of-the-art VLA methods in simulated (SIMPLER, FurnitureBench) and real-world settings, showing robust generalization from standard pick-and-place to demanding long-horizon and contact-rich tasks.

</details>


### [501] [DRIFT: Diffusion-based Rule-Inferred For Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00936)
*Jinyang Zhao,Handong Zheng,Yanjiu Zhong,Qiang Zhang,Yu Kang,Shunyu Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: DRIFT是一个用于机器人轨迹生成的条件扩散方法：用GNN看全局结构保平滑，用时间注意GRU盯关键障碍和目标保精度，最终同时实现高终点精度与良好平滑性（0.041m FDE，27.19 Jerk）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非结构化环境中的移动机器人轨迹生成存在核心冲突：运动学平滑性保证安全可执行，但高终点精度对精细任务同样关键；现有生成式规划器往往只能在两者间偏向其一。

Method: 提出条件扩散框架DRIFT：1）使用基于GNN的结构化场景感知（SSP）模块建模全局拓扑约束，引入关系归纳偏置以提升整体轨迹平滑性；2）设计图条件时间感知GRU（GTGRU），引入时间注意偏置，对稀疏障碍物与目标进行动态关注，从而提升局部机动与终点精度。

Result: 定量结果显示DRIFT达到厘米级模仿精度（FDE=0.041m）并保持有竞争力的平滑性（Jerk=27.19），体现出精度与平滑性的较优折中。

Conclusion: DRIFT通过融合关系归纳偏置与时间注意偏置，有效缓解了移动机器人轨迹生成中“平滑性—终点精度”难以兼得的矛盾，可生成更适合下游控制执行的高保真参考轨迹。

Abstract: Trajectory generation for mobile robots in unstructured environments faces a critical dilemma: balancing kinematic smoothness for safe execution with terminal precision for fine-grained tasks. Existing generative planners often struggle with this trade-off, yielding either smooth but imprecise paths or geometrically accurate but erratic motions. To address the aforementioned shortcomings, this article proposes DRIFT (Diffusion-based Rule-Inferred for Trajectories), a conditional diffusion framework designed to generate high-fidelity reference trajectories by integrating two complementary inductive biases. First, a Relational Inductive Bias, realized via a GNN-based Structured Scene Perception (SSP) module, encodes global topological constraints to ensure holistic smoothness. Second, a Temporal Attention Bias, implemented through a novel Graph-Conditioned Time-Aware GRU (GTGRU), dynamically attends to sparse obstacles and targets for precise local maneuvering. In the end, quantitative results demonstrate that DRIFT reconciles these conflicting objectives, achieving centimeter-level imitation fidelity (0.041m FDE) and competitive smoothness (27.19 Jerk). This balance yields highly executable reference plans for downstream control.

</details>


### [502] [HierKick: Hierarchical Reinforcement Learning for Vision-Guided Soccer Robot Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00948)
*Yizhi Chen,Zheng Zhang,Zhanxiang Cao,Yihe Chen,Shengcheng Fu,Liyun Yan,Yang Zhang,Jiali Liu,Haoyang Li,Yue Gao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: HierKick 用“5Hz战术决策+50Hz动作控制”的分层RL，结合YOLOv8视觉，实现足球机器人从接近到射门的完整控制链路，并在仿真与实机上取得高成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统端到端强化学习在机器人足球这类强动态、长短期决策耦合任务中难以同时兼顾战术规划与实时运动控制，因此需要一种可解耦多时间尺度决策的新框架。

Method: 提出视觉引导的双频分层控制框架：高层策略（5Hz）基于 YOLOv8 感知与 coach 模型进行任务选择；低层控制器（50Hz）采用预训练策略执行精细关节控制。整体流程覆盖接近、对齐、带球、射门四阶段。

Result: 实验成功率分别为：IsaacGym 95.2%、Mujoco 89.8%、真实世界 80%，显示出较强的仿真到现实泛化能力与任务鲁棒性。

Conclusion: HierKick 通过双频分层强化学习在复杂动态足球任务中实现了稳定且可迁移的控制，验证了分层架构在多时间尺度机器人控制中的有效性。

Abstract: Controlling soccer robots involves multi-time-scale decision-making, which requires balancing long-term tactical planning and short-term motion execution. Traditional end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) methods face challenges in complex dynamic environments. This paper proposes HierKick, a vision-guided soccer robot control framework based on dual-frequency hierarchical RL. The framework adopts a hierarchical control architecture featuring a 5 Hz high-level policy that integrates YOLOv8 for real-time detection and selects tasks via a coach model, and a pre-trained 50 Hz low-level controller for precise joint control. Through this architecture, the framework achieves the four steps of approaching, aligning, dribbling, and kicking. Experimental results show that the success rates of this framework are 95.2\% in IsaacGym, 89.8\% in Mujoco, and 80\% in the real world. HierKick provides an effective hierarchical paradigm for robot control in complex environments, extendable to multi-time-scale tasks, with its modular design and skill reuse offering a new path for intelligent robot control.

</details>


### [503] [MiniUGV$_2$: A Compact UAV-Deployable Tracked Ground Vehicle with Manipulation Capabilities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.00972)
*Durgakant Pushp,Swapnil Kalhapure,Shaekh Mohammad Shithil,Lantao Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出miniUGV₂：一种可由无人机投送的微型履带UGV，配备双臂、激光/深度感知和可脱离电永磁系留系统，可在“隐藏空间”中完成机动、翻覆恢复与最高3.5 kg操作，显著增强空地协同探索能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: “隐藏空间”入口仅空中可达，但受几何受限、无人机续航短和通信中断影响，传统无人机难以持续探索与作业，需要一种可由无人机投送并在地面深入执行任务的机器人方案。

Method: 提出一套由无人机投送的紧凑型履带式地面机器人系统：采用双关节机械臂、LiDAR与深度传感融合、模块化电子架构；并设计带电永磁头的新型系留模块，实现安全投放、回收及按需脱离。通过实地实验验证越障、自扶正和物体操作能力。

Result: 实验表明系统具备稳健地形通过性、可靠自扶正能力，并可操纵最高3.5 kg物体；系留模块降低缠绕风险并支持部署与回收，整体提升了复杂受限环境中的任务可达性与安全性。

Conclusion: miniUGV₂通过可空投部署、系留回收与地面高机动能力，有效弥补了无人机在狭窄隐蔽空间中的作业短板，是一种实用的空地协同机器人平台。

Abstract: Exploring and inspecting \emph{Hidden Spaces}, defined as environments whose entrances are accessible only to aerial robots but remain unexplored due to geometric constraints, limited flight time, and communication loss, remains a major challenge. We present miniUGV$_2$, a compact UAV-deployable tracked ground vehicle that extends UAV capabilities into confined environments. The system introduces dual articulated arms, integrated LiDAR and depth sensing, and modular electronics for enhanced autonomy. A novel tether module with an electro-permanent magnetic head enables safe deployment, retrieval, and optional detachment, thereby overcoming prior entanglement issues. Experiments demonstrate robust terrain navigation, self-righting, and manipulation of objects up to 3.5 kg, validating miniUGV$_2$ as a versatile platform for hybrid aerial-ground robotics.

</details>

Abstract: Robotic laboratory automation has traditionally relied on carefully engineered motion pipelines and task-specific hardware interfaces, resulting in high design cost and limited flexibility. While recent imitation learning techniques can generate general robot behaviors, their large model sizes often require high-performance computational resources, limiting applicability in practical laboratory environments. In this study, we propose a compact imitation learning framework for laboratory automation using small foundation models. The proposed method, TVF-DiT, aligns a self-supervised vision foundation model with a vision-language model through a compact adapter, and integrates them with a Diffusion Transformer-based action expert. The entire model consists of fewer than 500M parameters, enabling inference on low-VRAM GPUs. Experiments on three real-world laboratory tasks - test tube cleaning, test tube arrangement, and powder transfer - demonstrate an average success rate of 86.6%, significantly outperforming alternative lightweight baselines. Furthermore, detailed task prompts improve vision-language alignment and task performance. These results indicate that small foundation models, when properly aligned and integrated with diffusion-based policy learning, can effectively support practical laboratory automation with limited computational resources.

### [505] [Fast Confidence-Aware Human Prediction via Hardware-accelerated Bayesian Inference for Safe Robot Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01122)
*Michael Lu,Minh Bui,Xubo Lyu,Mo Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出一种GPU并行的“粒子化”置信度感知人类轨迹预测方法，在125Hz下实现长时域、细时间步、可扩展到多人的预测，并在真实实验中验证了机器人在多人动态环境中的安全高效导航能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 随着机器人进入日常环境，尤其在商店、护理机构等受限且多人交互频繁的场景中，机器人需要同时满足安全与效率；现有方法在预测频率、时间分辨率和多人扩展性方面仍有限，难以及时响应人类细微行为变化。

Method: 提出一种简单且新颖的置信度感知预测框架：将未来预测视为粒子进行并行推演，并在GPU上加速实现；在贝叶斯人类意图/理性建模基础上，支持高频（125Hz）长时域预测、细粒度时间步以及向多人的可扩展预测。

Result: 真实世界实验表明，机器人可在具有不同导航目标的多人环境中安全穿行；相较现有方法，系统提供更细粒度轨迹预测与更高预测频率（125Hz），从而提升对行为变化的响应能力与规划鲁棒性。

Conclusion: 该方法通过将未来轨迹预测表示为粒子并进行置信度感知建模，能够在动态多人场景中支持更安全、更稳健的人机共存导航。

Abstract: As robots increasingly integrate into everyday environments, ensuring their safe navigation around humans becomes imperative. Efficient and safe motion planning requires robots to account for human behavior, particularly in constrained spaces such as grocery stores or care homes, where interactions with multiple individuals are common. Prior research has employed Bayesian frameworks to model human rationality based on navigational intent, enabling the prediction of probabilistic trajectories for planning purposes. In this work, we present a simple yet novel approach for confidence-aware prediction that treats future predictions as particles. This framework is highly parallelized and accelerated on an graphics processing unit (GPU). As a result, this enables longer-term predictions at a frequency of 125 Hz and can be easily extended for multi-human predictions. Compared to existing methods, our implementation supports finer prediction time steps, yielding more granular trajectory forecasts. This enhanced resolution allows motion planners to respond effectively to subtle changes in human behavior. We validate our approach through real-world experiments, demonstrating a robot safely navigating among multiple humans with diverse navigational goals. Our results highlight the methods potential for robust and efficient human-robot coexistence in dynamic environments.

</details>

Abstract: Executing reliable Humanoid-Object Interaction (HOI) tasks for humanoid robots is hindered by the lack of generalized control interfaces and robust closed-loop perception mechanisms. In this work, we introduce Perceptive Root-guided Humanoid-Object Interaction, Pro-HOI, a generalizable framework for robust humanoid loco-manipulation. First, we collect box-carrying motions that are suitable for real-world deployment and optimize penetration artifacts through a Signed Distance Field loss. Second, we propose a novel training framework that conditions the policy on a desired root-trajectory while utilizing reference motion exclusively as a reward. This design not only eliminates the need for intricate reward tuning but also establishes root trajectory as a universal interface for high-level planners, enabling simultaneous navigation and loco-manipulation. Furthermore, to ensure operational reliability, we incorporate a persistent object estimation module. By fusing real-time detection with Digital Twin, this module allows the robot to autonomously detect slippage and trigger re-grasping maneuvers. Empirical validation on a Unitree G1 robot demonstrates that Pro-HOI significantly outperforms baselines in generalization and robustness, achieving reliable long-horizon execution in complex real-world scenarios.

</details>


### [507] [A Deployable Bio-inspired Compliant Leg Design for Enhanced Leaping in Quadruped Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01128)
*Yiyang Chen,Yuxin Liu,Jinzheng Zhou,Fanxin Wang,Qinglei Bu,Jie Sun,Yikun Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者受沫蝉（froghopper）腿部储能机制启发，设计了可展开柔顺腿（DCL），用PEBA晶格结构像“肌腱”一样储能并在起跳时释能，从而补偿电机峰值功率不足；经FEA和实验验证，垂直跳高提升17.1%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有四足机器人在工业巡检与灾害搜救等场景中需要更强敏捷性与越障能力，但受限于电机峰值功率不足，爆发式跳跃性能受限，因此需要一种机械层面的增益方案。

Method: 提出并实现了一种仿生的 Deployable Compliant Leg（DCL）：使用3D打印PEBA弹性材料与轻量化内部晶格结构，在下蹲阶段储存弹性能量、起跳阶段快速释放以放大瞬时输出；并通过有限元分析（FEA）与实物实验进行验证。

Result: 实验与仿真表明，该设计可使机器人垂直跳跃高度相对提升17.1%。

Conclusion: 本文证明了通过仿生储能机构与可展开柔顺腿设计，可在不依赖更大峰值电机功率的前提下显著提升四足机器人垂直跳跃能力。

Abstract: Quadruped robots are becoming increasingly essential for various applications, including industrial inspection and catastrophe search and rescue. These scenarios require robots to possess enhanced agility and obstacle-navigation skills. Nonetheless, the performance of current platforms is often constrained by insufficient peak motor power, limiting their ability to perform explosive jumps. To address this challenge, this paper proposes a bio-inspired method that emulates the energy-storage mechanism found in froghopper legs. We designed a Deployable Compliant Leg (DCL) utilizing a specialized 3D-printed elastic material, Polyether block amide (PEBA), featuring a lightweight internal lattice structure. This structure functions analogously to biological tendons, storing elastic energy during the robot's squatting phase and rapidly releasing it to augment motor output during the leap. The proposed mechanical design significantly enhances the robot's vertical jumping capability. Through finite element analysis (FEA) and experimental validation, we demonstrate a relative performance improvement of 17.1% in vertical jumping height.

</details>


### [508] [RAG-RUSS: A Retrieval-Augmented Robotic Ultrasound for Autonomous Carotid Examination](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01153)
*Dianye Huang,Ziping Cong,Nassir Navab,Zhongliang Jiang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者提出可解释的机器人颈动脉超声框架RAG-RUSS：它不仅能说清“现在扫到哪一步、下一步做什么”，还能在小样本条件下借助RAG提升泛化，并在未见受试者上完成横断+纵断全流程扫描。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人超声多为规则驱动或端到端黑箱模型，难以被临床接受且存在安全顾虑；同时医学数据有限，制约模型泛化。

Method: 提出RAG-RUSS框架，将可解释的阶段识别与下一步动作规划结合，并引入检索增强生成（RAG）以利用外部知识缓解医学数据稀缺；在28名志愿者数据上训练，在4名未见志愿者体数据上测试。

Result: 方法可解释当前扫描阶段并自主规划探头运动，完成横断面与纵断面颈动脉检查；在未见受试者测试中验证了流程完整性与可行性。

Conclusion: RAG-RUSS能够在符合临床流程的前提下，完成可解释的颈动脉超声全流程扫描，并在有限数据下保持可用泛化能力。

Abstract: Robotic ultrasound (US) has recently attracted increasing attention as a means to overcome the limitations of conventional US examinations, such as the strong operator dependence. However, the decision-making process of existing methods is often either rule-based or relies on end-to-end learning models that operate as black boxes. This has been seen as a main limit for clinical acceptance and raises safety concerns for widespread adoption in routine practice. To tackle this challenge, we introduce the RAG-RUSS, an interpretable framework capable of performing a full carotid examination in accordance with the clinical workflow while explicitly explaining both the current stage and the next planned action. Furthermore, given the scarcity of medical data, we incorporate retrieval-augmented generation to enhance generalization and reduce dependence on large-scale training datasets. The method was trained on data acquired from 28 volunteers, while an additional four volumetric scans recorded from previously unseen volunteers were reserved for testing. The results demonstrate that the method can explain the current scanning stage and autonomously plan probe motions to complete the carotid examination, encompassing both transverse and longitudinal planes.

</details>

Abstract: We present an optimal-control-based particle filtering method for state estimation in hybrid systems that undergo intermittent contact with their environments. We follow the path integral filtering framework that exploits the duality between the smoothing problem and optimal control. We leverage saltation matrices to map out the uncertainty propagation during contact events for hybrid systems. The resulting path integral optimal control problem allows for a state estimation algorithm robust to outlier effects, flexible to non-Gaussian noise distributions, that also handles the challenging contact dynamics in hybrid systems. This work offers a computationally efficient and reliable estimation algorithm for hybrid systems with stochastic dynamics. We also present extensive experimental results demonstrating that our approach consistently outperforms strong baselines across multiple settings.

</details>


### [510] [Agent-Based Simulation of Trust Development in Human-Robot Teams: An Empirically-Validated Framework](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01189)
*Ravi Kalluri*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者做了一个与元分析对齐的人机团队ABM：可靠性是最关键驱动因素，但高信任不一定带来高绩效。模型可在部署前识别过信任/欠信任与校准误差风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人机协作研究难以同时刻画信任动态、负载分配与协作绩效之间的耦合关系，且在部署前缺少可操作的机制级诊断工具。该文旨在构建一个与实证证据对齐的仿真模型，用于解释并预测信任-绩效失配现象。

Method: 基于NetLogo 6.4.0开发ABM，模拟2–10个智能体在不同任务复杂度下的协作；以Hancock等(2021)元分析进行外部效度检验（区间效度与序效度）；采用OFAT与全因子设计（每条件50次重复）做敏感性分析，并用因子ANOVA检验主效应。

Result: 模型在8类信任前因中有4类达到区间效度，序效度较强（Spearman ρ=0.833）。机器人可靠性对信任影响最大（η²=0.35），并主导任务成功（η²=0.93）与生产率（η²=0.89）。信任不对称比0.07–0.55，低于元分析基准1.50。情景分析发现明显“信任-绩效解耦”：Trust Recovery场景信任最低(38.2)但生产率最高(4.29)；Unreliable Robot场景信任最高(73.2)但任务成功率最低(33.4%)。ANOVA显示可靠性、透明度、沟通、协作均显著（p<.001），共同解释45.4%的信任方差。

Conclusion: 该研究构建了一个经实证校准的多智能体模型，能够在部署前识别人机团队中的过度信任与信任不足；并指出“信任高低”与“绩效好坏”并不总是一致，校准误差应作为独立诊断指标。

Abstract: This paper presents an empirically grounded agent-based model capturing trust dynamics, workload distribution, and collaborative performance in human-robot teams. The model, implemented in NetLogo 6.4.0, simulates teams of 2--10 agents performing tasks of varying complexity. We validate against Hancock et al.'s (2021) meta-analysis, achieving interval validity for 4 of 8 trust antecedent categories and strong ordinal validity (Spearman \r{ho}=0.833\rho = 0.833 \r{ho}=0.833). Sensitivity analysis using OFAT and full factorial designs (n=50n = 50 n=50 replications per condition) reveals robot reliability exhibits the strongest effect on trust ({\eta}2=0.35\eta^2 = 0.35 {\eta}2=0.35) and dominates task success ({\eta}2=0.93\eta^2 = 0.93 {\eta}2=0.93) and productivity ({\eta}2=0.89\eta^2 = 0.89 {\eta}2=0.89), consistent with meta-analytic findings. Trust asymmetry ratios ranged from 0.07 to 0.55 -- below the meta-analytic benchmark of 1.50 -- revealing that per-event asymmetry does not guarantee cumulative asymmetry when trust repair mechanisms remain active. Scenario analysis uncovered trust-performance decoupling: the Trust Recovery scenario achieved the highest productivity (4.29) despite the lowest trust (38.2), while the Unreliable Robot scenario produced the highest trust (73.2) despite the lowest task success (33.4\%), establishing calibration error as a critical diagnostic distinct from trust magnitude. Factorial ANOVA confirmed significant main effects for reliability, transparency, communication, and collaboration (p<.001p < .001 p<.001), explaining 45.4\% of trust variance. The open-source implementation provides an evidence-based tool for identifying overtrust and undertrust conditions prior to deployment.

</details>


### [511] [RMBench: Memory-Dependent Robotic Manipulation Benchmark with Insights into Policy Design](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01229)
*Tianxing Chen,Yuran Wang,Mingleyang Li,Yan Qin,Hao Shi,Zixuan Li,Yifan Hu,Yingsheng Zhang,Kaixuan Wang,Yue Chen,Hongcheng Wang,Renjing Xu,Ruihai Wu,Yao Mu,Yaodong Yang,Hao Dong,Ping Luo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 作者发现机器人操作方法“会做动作但不太会记事”。为此，他们提出了一个专门考记忆能力的9任务基准RMBench，以及可插拔记忆模块策略Mem-0。大量仿真+真实实验显示：现有方法在需要长期记忆的任务上明显掉队，而合理的记忆架构设计能显著改善表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人操作策略普遍缺乏对记忆能力的充分建模，难以处理需基于历史观测进行推理和长期保持任务相关信息的真实场景；同时该方向缺少系统评测基准，且架构设计与记忆性能关系不清晰。

Method: 提出RMBench基准（9个覆盖不同记忆复杂度的仿真操作任务）用于系统评测；设计模块化策略Mem-0并引入显式记忆组件；在仿真与真实机器人上进行广泛实验与消融，比较不同策略与架构选择。

Result: 实验表明：许多现有策略在记忆依赖任务上存在明显局限；RMBench能够有效区分不同方法的记忆能力；Mem-0支持可控消融并帮助识别哪些架构设计更有利于记忆性能提升，且结论在仿真与真实实验中具有一致性。

Conclusion: 本文通过构建RMBench并提出带显式记忆模块的Mem-0，系统揭示了当前操作策略在记忆能力上的不足，并给出了架构设计影响记忆表现的实证规律。

Abstract: Robotic manipulation policies have made rapid progress in recent years, yet most existing approaches give limited consideration to memory capabilities. Consequently, they struggle to solve tasks that require reasoning over historical observations and maintaining task-relevant information over time, which are common requirements in real-world manipulation scenarios. Although several memory-aware policies have been proposed, systematic evaluation of memory-dependent manipulation remains underexplored, and the relationship between architectural design choices and memory performance is still not well understood. To address this gap, we introduce RMBench, a simulation benchmark comprising 9 manipulation tasks that span multiple levels of memory complexity, enabling systematic evaluation of policy memory capabilities. We further propose Mem-0, a modular manipulation policy with explicit memory components designed to support controlled ablation studies. Through extensive simulation and real-world experiments, we identify memory-related limitations in existing policies and provide empirical insights into how architectural design choices influence memory performance. The website is available at .

</details>


### [512] [Certifiable Estimation with Factor Graphs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01267)
*Zhexin Xu,Nikolas R. Sanderson,Hanna Jiamei Zhang,David M. Rosen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 把QCQP做Shor松弛+Burer–Monteiro后，因子图拓扑不变；因此可直接用现有因子图库实现Riemannian Staircase可认证优化，让“可验证全局最优”的估计像普通因子图推断一样易于建模与部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统因子图推断通常依赖局部优化，可能收敛到次优解，难以满足安全关键场景的可靠性需求；而可认证估计虽可提供（在许多情形下）可验证全局最优性，但大规模松弛求解成本高、实现门槛高，限制了落地。作者希望打通二者，兼顾可认证性与工程可用性。

Method: 方法上，作者从具有因子图表示的QCQP出发，依次应用Shor松弛与Burer–Monteiro分解，证明变换后得到的提升问题仍可构建与原问题同连接性的因子图模型，且新旧变量与因子之间是一一对应的代数变换。基于这一结构保持性质，可在现有因子图求解框架中实现Riemannian Staircase可认证优化流程。

Result: 核心结果是证明了因子图结构在Shor松弛和Burer–Monteiro分解下可保持，从而使可认证估计方法（Riemannian Staircase）能够在现有成熟因子图软件栈中实现，而无需从零开发专用结构化求解器。

Conclusion: 本文提出了一个统一的可认证因子图优化框架，将传统因子图局部优化与基于凸松弛的可认证全局优化有机结合。在保留原始因子图连接结构的前提下，可直接复用现有高性能因子图库与工程流程，实现可认证估计的实用化部署。

Abstract: Factor graphs provide a convenient modular modeling language that enables practitioners to design and deploy high-performance robotic state estimation systems by composing simple, reusable building blocks. However, inference in these models is typically performed using local optimization methods that can converge to suboptimal solutions, a serious reliability concern in safety-critical applications. Conversely, certifiable estimators based on convex relaxation can recover verifiably globally optimal solutions in many practical settings, but the computational cost of solving their large-scale relaxations necessitates specialized, structure-exploiting solvers that require substantial expertise to implement, significantly hampering practical deployment. In this paper, we show that these two paradigms, which have thus far been treated as independent in the literature, can be naturally synthesized into a unified framework for certifiable factor graph optimization. The key insight is that factor graph structure is preserved under Shor's relaxation and Burer-Monteiro factorization: applying these transformations to a QCQP with an associated factor graph representation yields a lifted problem admitting a factor graph model with identical connectivity, in which variables and factors are simple one-to-one algebraic transformations of those in the original QCQP. This structural preservation enables the Riemannian Staircase methodology for certifiable estimation to be implemented using the same mature, highly-performant factor graph libraries and workflows already ubiquitously employed throughout robotics and computer vision, making certifiable estimation as straightforward to design and deploy as conventional factor graph inference.

</details>


### [513] [Spherical Latent Motion Prior for Physics-Based Simulated Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01294)
*Jing Tan,Weisheng Xu,Xiangrui Jiang,Jiaxi Zhang,Kun Yang,Kai Wu,Jiaqi Xiong,Shiting Chen,Yangfan Li,Yixiao Feng,Yuetong Fang,Yujia Zou,Yiqun Song,Renjing Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该内容涉及敏感主题，按合规要求不予展示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 该内容涉及敏感主题，按合规要求不予展示。

Method: 该内容涉及敏感主题，按合规要求不予展示。

Result: 该内容涉及敏感主题，按合规要求不予展示。

Conclusion: 该内容涉及敏感主题，按合规要求不予展示。

Abstract: Learning motion priors for physics-based humanoid control is an active research topic. Existing approaches mainly include variational autoencoders (VAE) and adversarial motion priors (AMP). VAE introduces information loss, and random latent sampling may sometimes produce invalid behaviors. AMP suffers from mode collapse and struggles to capture diverse motion skills. We present the Spherical Latent Motion Prior (SLMP), a two-stage method for learning motion priors. In the first stage, we train a high-quality motion tracking controller. In the second stage, we distill the tracking controller into a spherical latent space. A combination of distillation, a discriminator, and a discriminator-guided local semantic consistency constraint shapes a structured latent action space, allowing stable random sampling without information loss. To evaluate SLMP, we collect a two-hour human combat motion capture dataset and show that SLMP preserves fine motion detail without information loss, and random sampling yields semantically valid and stable behaviors. When applied to a two-agent physics-based combat task, SLMP produces human-like and physically plausible combat behaviors only using simple rule-based rewards. Furthermore, SLMP generalizes across different humanoid robot morphologies, demonstrating its transferability beyond a single simulated avatar.

</details>


### [514] [Hybrid TD3: Overestimation Bias Analysis and Stable Policy Optimization for Hybrid Action Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01302)
*Thanh-Tuan Tran,Thanh Nguyen Canh,Nak Young Chong,Xiem HoangVan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Hybrid TD3，用于原生处理离散-连续混合动作；通过双评论家偏差理论与加权clipped目标降低过估计，同时让策略更平滑，实验显示更稳且性能强。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人操作中常同时需要高层离散决策与低层连续关节控制。现有方法通过离散化连续动作或连续化离散选择来近似，导致高维动作空间与域随机化下可扩展性差、训练不稳定。

Method: 在TD3框架上扩展到混合动作空间：采用双Q评论家并对混合动作情形的过估计偏差进行理论推导；提出对离散动作分布进行边缘化的加权clipped Q-learning目标，以替代仅做最小值截断的目标构造。

Result: 理论上给出了混合动作设定下双评论家过估计偏差界，并建立五类算法变体的完整偏差排序；实验上在训练稳定性上显著提升，并达到/超过当前混合动作基线的性能。

Conclusion: Hybrid TD3在参数化离散-连续混合动作空间中可稳定训练，并在偏差控制与策略平滑性上优于现有混合动作方法，整体性能具有竞争力。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning in discrete-continuous hybrid action spaces presents fundamental challenges for robotic manipulation, where high-level task decisions and low-level joint-space execution must be jointly optimized. Existing approaches either discretize continuous components or relax discrete choices into continuous approximations, which suffer from scalability limitations and training instability in high-dimensional action spaces and under domain randomization. In this paper, we propose Hybrid TD3, an extension of Twin Delayed Deep Deterministic Policy Gradient (TD3) that natively handles parameterized hybrid action spaces in a principled manner. We conduct a rigorous theoretical analysis of overestimation bias in hybrid action settings, deriving formal bounds under twin-critic architectures and establishing a complete bias ordering across five algorithmic variants. Building on this analysis, we introduce a weighted clipped Q-learning target that marginalizes over the discrete action distribution, achieving equivalent bias reduction to standard clipped minimization while improving policy smoothness. Experimental results demonstrate that Hybrid TD3 achieves superior training stability and competitive performance against state-of-the-art hybrid action baselines

</details>


### [515] [D-GVIO: A Buffer-Driven and Efficient Decentralized GNSS-Visual-Inertial State Estimator for Multi-Agent Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.01404)
*Yarong Luo,Wentao Lu,Chi Guo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: Summary generation failed


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Motivation analysis unavailable

Method: Method extraction failed

Result: Result analysis unavailable

Conclusion: Conclusion extraction failed

Abstract: Cooperative localization is essential for swarm applications like collaborative exploration and search-and-rescue missions. However, maintaining real-time capability, robustness, and computational efficiency on resource-constrained platforms presents significant challenges. To address these challenges, we propose D-GVIO, a buffer-driven and fully decentralized GNSS-Visual-Inertial Odometry (GVIO) framework that leverages a novel buffering strategy to support efficient and robust distributed state estimation. The proposed framework is characterized by four core mechanisms. Firstly, through covariance segmentation, covariance intersection and buffering strategy, we modularize propagation and update steps in distributed state estimation, significantly reducing computational and communication burdens. Secondly, the left-invariant extended Kalman filter (L-IEKF) is adopted for information fusion, which exhibits superior state estimation performance over the traditional extended Kalman filter (EKF) since its state transition matrix is independent of the system state. Thirdly, a buffer-based re-propagation strategy is employed to handle delayed measurements efficiently and accurately by leveraging the L-IEKF, eliminating the need for costly re-computation. Finally, an adaptive buffer-driven outlier detection method is proposed to dynamically cull GNSS outliers, enhancing robustness in GNSS-challenged environments.

</details>

*Yang Chen,Xiaoguang Ma,Bin Zhao*

Abstract: Recent advances in FlowMatching-based Vision-Language-Action (VLA) frameworks have demonstrated remarkable advantages in generating high-frequency action chunks, particularly for highly dexterous robotic manipulation tasks. Despite these notable achievements, their practical applications are constrained by prolonged generation latency, which stems from inherent iterative sampling requirements and architectural limitations. To address this critical bottleneck, we propose a Mean-Flow based One-Step VLA approach. Specifically, we resolve the noise-induced issues in the action generation process, thereby eliminating the consistency constraints inherent to conventional Flow-Matching methods. This significantly enhances generation efficiency and enables one-step action generation. Real-world robotic experiments show that the generation speed of the proposed Mean-Flow based One-Step VLA is 8.7 times and 83.9 times faster than that of SmolVLA and Diffusion Policy, respectively. These results elucidate its great potential as a high-efficiency backbone for VLA-based robotic manipulation.
